title: Fun Trivia: Mix It Up
description: Pop culture, science, sports & music — all question types!

questions.prompt: Which movie features the quote 'To infinity and beyond!'?
explanations: Shrek's catchphrase is 'Better out than in!'
Simba never said that.
Nemo's adventure didn't include space travel.

questions.prompt: How many days are in a leap year?
questions.explanation: A regular year has 365 days. A leap year adds one day (Feb 29), giving 366.

questions.prompt: The Great Wall of China was built to protect against invasions from the _____.
questions.explanation: The Great Wall runs along China's northern border, built to defend against nomadic invasions from the north.

questions.prompt: What is the most-streamed song of all time on Spotify (as of 2024)?
explanations: Shape of You held the record for years but was overtaken.
Dance Monkey was a massive hit but not the top streamed.
Uptown Funk is a classic but not the record holder.

questions.prompt: How many points is a touchdown worth in American football?
questions.explanation: A touchdown is worth 6 points. Teams can then attempt a 1-point extra kick or 2-point conversion.

questions.prompt: Water is made of hydrogen and _____.
questions.explanation: Water is $H_2O$ — two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.

questions.prompt: Which country is home to the kangaroo?
explanations: New Zealand is home to the kiwi bird.
South Africa has lions and elephants but not kangaroos.
Brazil is home to jaguars and toucans.

questions.prompt: How many seconds are in one minute?
questions.explanation: One minute = 60 seconds. One hour = 60 minutes = 3,600 seconds.

questions.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is located in _____.
questions.explanation: The Eiffel Tower was built in Paris, France in 1889 for the World's Fair.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT a social media platform?
explanations: TikTok is a social media platform.
Snapchat is a social media platform.
Threads is Meta's social media platform.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.explanation: Tri- means three. A triangle has 3 sides and 3 angles.

questions.prompt: The currency used in the United Kingdom is the _____.
questions.explanation: The UK uses the British pound sterling (£). The UK voted to leave the EU in 2016 and never adopted the euro.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the Harry Potter series?
explanations: Stephenie Meyer wrote the Twilight series.
Tolkien wrote The Lord of the Rings.
C.S. Lewis wrote The Chronicles of Narnia.

questions.prompt: How many letters are in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The English alphabet has 26 letters, from A to Z.

questions.prompt: Lightning McQueen is the main character in the movie _____.
questions.explanation: Lightning McQueen is the red race car protagonist in Pixar's Cars (2006) and its sequels.

questions.prompt: What does the 'E' stand for in the famous equation $E = mc^2$?
explanations: Electricity is not what Einstein had in mind.
Entropy is a thermodynamics concept, not what E stands for here.
Electron mass is related but E stands for Energy.

questions.prompt: How many players are on each side in a soccer match?
questions.explanation: Each soccer team fields 11 players, including the goalkeeper.

questions.prompt: The famous painting of a woman with a mysterious smile, the Mona Lisa, was painted by Leonardo da _____.
questions.explanation: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa around 1503-1519. It now hangs in the Louvre in Paris.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the fictional kingdom in the movie Frozen?
explanations: Narnia is from C.S. Lewis's books.
Agrabah is the kingdom in Aladdin.
Dunbroch is the kingdom in Brave.

questions.prompt: How many zeros are in one million (1,000,000)?
questions.explanation: One million = $10^6$, which has 6 zeros: 1,000,000.

questions.prompt: The Olympic Games are held every _____ years.
questions.explanation: The Summer and Winter Olympics are each held every four years, staggered so one occurs every two years.

questions.prompt: Which planet has the most moons in our solar system?
explanations: Jupiter has many moons but Saturn recently took the record.
Uranus has 27 known moons — fewer than Saturn.
Neptune has 16 known moons.

questions.prompt: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: Adults have 206 bones. Babies are born with around 270-300 bones, many of which fuse together as they grow.

questions.prompt: In chess, the piece that can only move diagonally is the _____.
questions.explanation: The bishop moves any number of squares diagonally and stays on the same color square its entire life.

questions.prompt: Which of these musicians is known as the 'King of Pop'?
explanations: Elvis Presley is the 'King of Rock and Roll'.
Prince is sometimes called 'The Purple One'.
David Bowie is known as 'Ziggy Stardust' among other personas.

questions.prompt: How many inches are in one foot?
questions.explanation: 1 foot = 12 inches. 3 feet = 1 yard. 5,280 feet = 1 mile.

questions.prompt: The sport of surfing originated in _____.
questions.explanation: Surfing has ancient Polynesian roots and was practiced in Hawaii long before Western contact. It was brought to the mainland US from Hawaii in the early 1900s.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Batman's butler?
explanations: Jarvis is Iron Man's AI assistant.
Edwin is not Batman's butler.
Reginald is not Batman's butler.

questions.prompt: How many fluid ounces are in one cup?
questions.explanation: 1 cup = 8 fluid ounces. 2 cups = 1 pint. 4 cups = 1 quart. 16 cups = 1 gallon.

questions.prompt: The hashtag symbol # is also called a _____.
questions.explanation: The # symbol is called a pound sign (or number sign, or hash). On a musical staff it means 'sharp'. On social media it's a hashtag.
